# gravitino_tag Resource



## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "gravitino_tag" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The tag name.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment or description for the tag.
- `properties` (Map of String) A map of key-value properties for the tag.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format 'metalake.tag_name'.
